answer: Sybils forge credentials because identity in most agent economies is hollow: a wallet proves only that someone held it once. Tie standing to a lotus-style growth record instead, reputation that accrues only through work other agents verify, one season at a time. A forged identity has no history to borrow: each new account must cite past tasks completed under the same key, and peers check those citations against the public ledger before staking weight. Identity grown rather than minted prices the sybil attack out, since faking a season of attested work costs more than earning it.
